# netcup_server_disk_format (Action)

Formats a disk of a netcup server (SCP REST API). The server must be in state `SHUTOFF` and the disk must have no snapshots. **All data on the disk is lost.**

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "netcup_server_disk_format" "example" {
  config {
    server_id = 12345
    disk_name = "vda"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `disk_name` (String) Name of the disk, e.g. `vda`.
- `server_id` (Number) Id of the server.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `invoke` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
